sourceNote: Candidate includes uncommitted worker terrain preparation, shared node graphs, distant draw clustering and disabled optional canopy shader path. Prewarm is off. Built world entry world-TUw0qxic.js and runtime/core match the final validation build; editor-only cancellation was fixed after timing.
limitations: One resident-view pair, candidate then baseline; workstation/clock variability remains. No universal speedup claim.
World FPS counts submissions and can queue GPU work. It is not GPU completion or monitor scanout, and differs from the bounded water queue.

Resident timing starts only after tile ready and five seconds warmup; selected terrain detail/residents match. Initial loading may overlap the tail of the preceding build, so startup timing is excluded.
Traversal contains changes in resident content. Its aggregate pass is not sustained dense-forest acceptance.
Earlier prewarm-on and on-battery trials are excluded from improvement claims.
Counters omit workers, browser/driver allocations and global caches.

acceptance.reason: Forest p95 remains 50 ms. Original aggregate meets30FPS=true hides this failure; raw report below is unchanged.
